zelda-breath-of-the-wild game sourced

The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

An open-world action adventure whose physics and chemistry engines let fire, wind, electricity, temperature, and material properties combine, so puzzles and fights accept solutions the designers did not script.

2017Nintendo EPDSandbox worldcluster c0510 mechanics
this record asyaml sourcemarkdownjson

core loop

spot a landmark -> climb, glide, or ride toward it under stamina limits -> solve shrines and fights with physics and elemental interactions -> gather and cook ingredients -> replace broken weapons -> push farther into the world

design notes

The game is mostly authored content (map, shrines, story) and is included for its systemic layer. A modified Havok physics engine and a separate chemistry engine give objects material properties, so fire burns grass and creates updrafts, metal draws lightning and conducts electricity, wind carries flames and gliders, and cold or heat drains health unless countered by clothing or cooked food. Weapon durability and stamina force continual scavenging and route choice, and shrine puzzles accept any solution that satisfies the physical end condition.

relations

10 stored edges
uses

Material interactions

The chemistry engine gives objects properties such as flammable, metallic, or conductive; fire ignites wood and grass, metal attracts lightning in storms and conducts electricity, and ice melts near fire.

core
uses

Rigid-body physics

A modified Havok engine moves crates, boulders, and weapons; Magnesis lifts metal objects, Stasis freezes an object so stored hits launch it, and Cryonis raises ice pillars from water, giving shrines and fights unscripted solutions.

core
uses

Survival meters

A stamina wheel limits sprinting, climbing, swimming, and gliding; hearts are health, and ambient cold and heat damage the player without matching clothing or elixirs.

core
uses

Day-night cycle

Time of day changes enemy and creature activity, and the Blood Moon respawns defeated enemies.

supporting
uses

Direct avatar control

Link can climb almost any surface, glide, ride horses, and use runes.

supporting
uses

Fire spread

Fire spreads across grass in the wind direction and produces updrafts that the paraglider can ride.

supporting
uses

Hand crafting

Cooking combines up to five ingredients in a pot into meals or elixirs whose effects and duration depend on the ingredients.

supporting
uses

Heat transfer

Region temperature and fire sources set a temperature gauge that damages the player beyond tolerance.

supporting
uses

Wear and breakdown

Weapons, bows, and shields lose durability with use and shatter; the Master Sword recharges instead.

supporting
uses

Weather

Rain makes surfaces too slippery to climb, and thunderstorms strike metal equipment with lightning.
